name: Angel Breath
source:
Magic is used to heal not only wounds but people as well. Takashi is a student at a magic therapy school. One day, a loud explosion strikes at a dormitory and he finds two strange women lying there...

First disc contains, as bonus, fighting mini-game "Angel Savior" (エンジェルセイヴァー) with characters from "Angel Breath".

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
魔法不仅可以治愈伤口，也能疗愈人心。隆是一名魔法治疗学校的学生。一天，宿舍传来巨响，他在那里发现两名陌生女性倒在地上…

第一张光盘还附赠格斗小游戏《Angel Savior》，其中会有《Angel Breath》的角色登场。

[摘自ErogeShop]
